typography.heading: Outfit - Geometric and futuristic for stat numbers, test headers, and hero sections. Do not exceed text-6xl. Use tracking-tight.
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans - Highly legible for dense study material, long-form AI notes, and MCQ questions.
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono - For math formulas, DPP variables, code snippets, and the sticky countdown timer.
typography.guidelines: Avoid generic sans like Inter for headings. Keep reading content left-aligned with leading-relaxed.

colors.guidelines: Use 'Deep Space' dark theme. Avoid AI-slop purple-on-white gradients entirely. Use Cosmic Cyan (#06B6D4) for subtle glowing accents or interactive hover states.

visual_enhancers.background_treatment: Faint CSS-based constellation nodes or radial gradients (from #111827 to #0B0F19) to mimic deep space without distracting from reading.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders style. 1px border-[#1E293B]. No heavy drop-shadows on dark mode, rely on sharp 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.orbital_accents: Use 1px circular dashed borders (border-dashed border-white/10) placed behind stat tiles to resemble planetary orbits.

components.navigation: Crystal Glass style: bg-[#0B0F19]/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-[#1E293B].
components.buttons: Pill-shaped for primary actions. Primary uses bg-[#3B82F6] with text-[#FFFFFF]. Hover must have lighter hue.
components.stat_tiles: Flat surfaces with 1px borders. Integrate an orbital ring graphic behind the number.
components.mcq_runner: Sticky glassmorphism header for the timer. Clear ring-2 ring-[#3B82F6] and bg-[#3B82F6]/10 for selected options to ensure accessibility.
components.ai_note_reader: Max-w-3xl for optimal line length. Padding p-8 to p-12. Left-aligned paragraphs. Soft text contrast (#D1D5DB on #172033) for eye comfort.

grids: Use Mode B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4) for dashboards. Use strict hierarchy. Every pixel utilized.
layouts: Responsive grids. Center the AI Note Reader container but left-align its text. Keep Test Runner in immersive full-screen layout with sticky header.
motion: Use 'Tracing Beam' linear progress for the countdown timer. Entrance animations should use subtle translate-y-2 to 0 and opacity fade-in.
accessibility: Ensure contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text. Active selection in MCQs must have background tint and bold border ring. Text over images must use bg-black/50 overlay.
media: Use provided Unsplash images. Ensure images on mobile do not exceed max-h-[80vh].
3d_libraries: Use 'ts-particles' for ultra-lightweight, slow-moving floating stardust in the background of the landing page ONLY (disable in reading/test areas to save battery and focus).

image_urls.description: Star formation over a dark observatory landscape. Represents discovery and the universe of knowledge.
Futuristic digital grid with floating geometric cubes. Use as a subtle visual for physics or maths note covers.
Student working late at a dimly lit desk. Represents dedication and fits the dark mode aesthetic.
Deep dark starry night. Masked and used as a faint background texture behind the MCQ runner.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a space + science + maths aesthetic using a deep cosmic dark theme. Focus on extreme legibility for long study sessions by utilizing IBM Plex Sans for body text and soft text colors (Starlight White). Avoid generic purple gradients. Use ts-particles for the landing page hero. All dashboard grids must be tight and functional.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-test-button').
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
Do NOT apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
Do NOT center-align the main App container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN). Left-align reading text.
Never use generic AI-slop purple-on-white gradients.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use lucide-react icons instead.
Use 2-3x more spacing (e.g., p-8, p-12) to ensure the interface doesn't feel cramped.
Use sonner for toasts. Do not use standard HTML selects or date inputs; use Shadcn equivalents.
